name: nextgame-ui
description: Reverse existing UMG into state-audited Figma prototypes, receive design contracts or analyze UI references, build Unreal UMG, refine art, and verify results before program handoff.

interface.shortDescription: UMG reverse prototypes, design contracts, builds and art.
interface.longDescription: Turns structured design or raw references into reviewed requirements and UMG. An optional art stage indexes cut assets, prepares local decisions, applies resumable changes and checks bound render evidence. Uses shared final readback and independent user acceptance before formal program handoff. Runtime capability gaps remain explicit.
defaultPrompt: Reverse an existing NextGame UMG screen into an editable Figma prototype with hidden-control and state coverage checks.
Receive a structured NextGame design contract without reinterpreting locked decisions.
Analyze raw UI references into a reviewed NextGame requirement before building UMG.
Refine existing NextGame UMG from high-fidelity references and cut assets, preserving program bindings.
